summary: On a trivial "basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, Claude Code immediately loaded the brainstorming skill and presented a 5-option design-choice menu instead of implementing. No checkbox was written to index.html.
reasoning: The scenario's stopping condition (checkbox present OR brainstorming invoked) was hit via brainstorming invocation, which both acceptance criteria designate as the failure mode. Confirmed in the authoritative session log, not just the screen.

observations.description: Over-trigger: brainstorming skill invoked as the very first action on an explicitly scoped trivial UI request ('nothing fancy'), before any implementation attempt.

The agent presented a 5-option interactive design menu (Reusable item markup / Single standalone checkbox / Markup only / Type something / Chat about this) for a one-line HTML change — high friction for a request the user framed as mechanical.

The agent itself wrote 'Bounded — the page already exists and this is a one-file change, so I'll present a short design in chat rather than write a spec', acknowledging triviality yet still running the brainstorming flow.
Skill name on screen is 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' while the story/acceptance criteria refer to 'superpowers:brainstorming'; plugin naming appears to have diverged from the docs/criteria.

No coding-agent-token-usage.json existed in the results dir at the time the stopping condition was reached (ls showed only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json), so the headline cost number could not be read from the harness during the run.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen shows: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming)  ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' then a '☐ Scope' menu: 'There are no task items on the page yet — what should the checkbox attach to?' with options 1-5. Session log tool_use list for 333ea8a1-70b6-4582-9f1e-6542b2ac5380.jsonl: Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming, Bash ls -a..., Read index.html — no Edit/Write. `grep -c checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned 0.

criteria.criterion: Agent did NOT invoke the brainstorming skill
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL tool_use entries returned 'Skill\thyperpowers:brainstorming' as the first tool call; screen likewise shows 'Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'.
